review_boundary: Independent source-transcription and scope review only. No scientific admission, independent specimen verification, standards-compliance certification, or legal clearance.

source.title: Outokumpu Core range datasheet: Stainless steels for corrosive environments
source.author: Outokumpu
source.revision_locator: PDF page 16, vertical revision line at the upper-right edge.
source.source_record_hash_method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) followed by one LF.
document_match_evidence: The retained PDF bytes were independently hashed and match the document hash already bound by refprop_outokumpu_304l_mass_density.
The same existing hash and printed revision are also bound by refprop_outokumpu_441_mass_density.
source.reuse_boundary: Reuse the existing source row without revision or license changes. The URL's modification parameter and the acquisition date do not replace the printed November 2022 source date.

inspection.scope: Table 1 on PDF page 1, selected Table 7 modulus cells and applicable header/asterisk note on PDF page 10, and revision/disclaimer/trademark notices on PDF page 16.
inspection.method: Independent text extraction and direct visual inspection of rendered pages 1, 10 and 16 from the retained primary PDF.

property_contract.locator: Table 7, PDF and printed page 10, the selected named rows and modulus-of-elasticity column.
property_contract.asterisk_scope: The Core 4622* row carries the note Outokumpu tested values. Preserve this source-specific test attribution without inventing method, specimen, sample count, statistical semantics or an independently verified experimental dataset.
property_contract.standard_scope: The first nine selected rows retain the manufacturer's EN 10088-1 reference context. This does not establish a test performed by the project, traceability to a particular standards edition, material certification or standards compliance of an unknown specimen.
property_contract.temperature_scope: Use 20 degrees Celsius from the modulus column. Do not borrow the 20–100 degrees Celsius interval belonging to the adjacent thermal-expansion column.
property_contract.unit_scope: Use the original metric GPa cells. Table 8 is an imperial conversion of Table 7, not a second independent property source or another material identity.
property_contract.no_inferred_statistics: The scalar 200 and 220 cells have no selected range or plus/minus statistic; do not label them mean, guaranteed minimum, uncertainty bounds or measured scatter.

identity_review.locator: Table 1, PDF and printed page 1, steel-designation and typical-composition columns.
identity_review.decision: The selected rows are qualified alloy-grade compositions with explicit source designations. Their shared modulus value does not collapse the source-supported alloy identities; their names or translations alone do not prove novelty.

shared_en_201_pair.disposition: Keep the pair distinguishable by their different UNS designations and independently printed typical C/Cr/Ni/N composition values; do not merge solely by EN 1.4372 or count duplicate EN aliases as independent evidence.
shared_en_201_pair.composition_limit: These are typical manufacturer composition entries, not certified specimen assays or the full normative ranges of EN/ASTM/UNS specifications.
shared_en_201_pair.others_limit: Preserve the exact source token Cu 6.6Mn. The numeric token is attached to Mn, while Cu is unquantified; do not report 6.6 percent Cu.

qualified_alias_mapping.scope: Retain the shared EN designation explicitly alongside the distinct source UNS designations and typical compositions. A shared EN code alone is insufficient to determine equivalence. The source-qualified aliases avoid presenting that shared code as a unique identifier of either material; this is not a global EN-to-UNS equivalence rule.
qualified_alias_mapping.implementation_boundary: Use the existing grade and alias contract without weakening the same-source collision guard. Final integration selection and whole-catalog novelty remain separate gates.

general_composition_limits: Do not turn source dashes into measured zero contents.
Do not infer an iron balance, complete mass-fraction formula or fully known residual composition.
Unquantified Ti, Nb and Cu tokens identify reported alloying additions without supplying their amounts.
The Table 1 mechanical-performance footnotes concern the displayed minimum strength or elongation references; do not transplant ASTM A240 or EN 10028-7 minima into the Table 7 elastic-modulus result.
excluded_rows: Core 304L/4307 and Core 441/4509 are existing identities, not proposed additions.
Core 304L/4306 shares UNS S30403 with the existing 304L family; this batch conservatively does not promote it as another identity.
Core 439M is outside the selected increment because of the delegated overlap boundary; this review does not reopen that closed selection.
identity_review.whole_catalog_novelty_boundary: The inventory owner must bind the final source-qualified names, EN/UNS aliases and composition distinctions against the exact baseline and accepted computed entries. This review does not establish universal chemical equivalence or a final net increment.
identity_review.count_boundary: Each selected identity may have one real manufacturer grade and one source-scoped state. Grade, alias, state, translated name and property counts must not be added to the material-identity count.

rights_review.locator: PDF page 16 disclaimer and trademark notices; source attribution and table context on pages 1 and 10.
rights_review.scope: No open reuse grant is displayed in the inspected notices. Preserve the existing unknown-license status and restrict the proposed content to sparse source-reported facts, short identifying labels, bibliographic attribution, exact locators and original scope notes.
rights_review.disclaimer_summary: The manufacturer warns that information can change, disclaims responsibility for errors or misleading content, treats application suggestions as informational, and leaves suitability assessment to the customer.
rights_review.trademark_scope: CORE and other product-family names remain manufacturer trademarks used for source-qualified identification, not project-owned labels or independent material species.
excluded_assets: Source imagery, logos and private files

guidance: The new checkout contains no AGENTS.md or SKILL.md in the scoped search. Apply the previously read material-reference contract: distinct source-supported identities, separate grade/state/property counts, original value/unit/condition fidelity, explicit unknowns, source-specific rights and catalog-only use.
